citation_policy: Every file:line citation in this matrix and its markdown mirror resolves exactly at the recorded base commit (HEAD of the worktree when generated). Citations point at registrations, guards or denial paths in the server implementation, never at UI labels alone.
derivation: Grant and scope facts are derived from the admin server's mount and middleware chain (services/admin/handlers/router.go and the per-domain mount files) plus the guard helpers they invoke. The dashboard nav gates (web/dashboard/src/App.tsx NAV_SECTIONS) are recorded as UI facts and cross-checked against the server chain; where they disagree, the server chain is authoritative and the disagreement is listed under warts.

grant_vocabulary.root-session: Admin session with the root flag; enforced by adminauth.MustBeRoot (pkg/adminauth/auth.go:466, 403 at pkg/adminauth/auth.go:471).
grant_vocabulary.org-permission: Root passes; otherwise the caller's role on the target org must carry the permission (services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:138; 400 'org target required' at services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:147; 403 'insufficient permission for this organization' at services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:152). Permission constants: pkg/adminstore/permissions.go:37-58.
grant_vocabulary.org-role: Root passes; otherwise the caller's org role must rank at or above the minimum (services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:113; 403 at services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:127). Roles: pkg/adminstore/roles.go:24-32.
grant_vocabulary.global-audit-role: Root or a root-authorized platform security_auditor global role; org memberships are deliberately not consulted (services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:186; 403 at services/admin/handlers/roles_authz.go:204).
grant_vocabulary.any-admin-session: Any authenticated admin session; no org or root gate beyond the session + CSRF chain (services/admin/handlers/router.go:747-748).
grant_vocabulary.internal-service-key: X-Admin-Key header compared in constant time; only the /internal group accepts it (services/admin/handlers/internal_api.go:28, pkg/adminauth/auth.go:496).
grant_vocabulary.scim-bearer: SCIM bearer token issued per org via the members-manage admin surface (services/admin/handlers/router_scim.go:48-50).
grant_vocabulary.api-key: Gateway API-key data plane, outside the admin session surface (services/admin/handlers/router_ops.go:85).

org_scope_vocabulary.org-bound: The target org is part of the request (path param or org_id query); a foreign org is rejected or hidden.
org_scope_vocabulary.orgless: No org dimension: the resource is platform-global.
org_scope_vocabulary.unavailable: Registered in the route inventory but not mounted at the recorded commit; the protected router answers a JSON 404 (services/admin/handlers/router.go:753).
org_scope_vocabulary.deployment-dependent: Mounted and guarded, but only reachable when a gateway deployment exposes the plane.
org_scope_vocabulary.none: The page performs no API calls (launcher).

session_chain.protected: Session re-validation (services/admin/handlers/router.go:747) + CSRF (services/admin/handlers/router.go:748); every dashboard route below rides this chain before its specific grant.
session_chain.root-group: Single root CRUD group: adminauth.MustBeRoot (services/admin/handlers/router.go:770) + OrgScopeMiddleware for org-scoped mutations (services/admin/handlers/router.go:777).

warts.fact: The exports nav gate references budgets.read, which no server permission defines; /api/me never serves it, so the entry is hidden for every non-root admin and the bound spend-alert endpoints are root-only anyway.

The mcp-credentials screen targets GET/DELETE /api/organizations/{id}/mcp/user-credentials, which is deliberately not registered (MC-4 contract hole; the UI renders an explicit unavailable state on 404), and the gateway flows POST /api/mcp/credentials/{server}, POST /api/mcp/auth/{server}/begin exist only on deployments exposing the gateway plane. The admin-side MC-1 server credential IS mounted (router_mcp.go:54-56); its dashboard caller is the mcp-credentials screen, not org-settings (McpCredentialsPage.tsx:307/:345/:362; OrgSettingsPage calls only listMcpServers/updateMcpServer at router_mcp.go:17/:19).

yb pricing sync sends the X-Admin-Key service key against GET /api/models and POST /api/pricing/import, but only the /internal group accepts that header; the session surface answers 401. The command needs a server-side resolution (internal mirrors or documented session use).
GET /api/organizations/{id}/requests/export and /requests/archive-search are registered and requests.read-gated but no dashboard module calls them at this commit.

The guard-packs screen also lists the audit journal (root group plus global-audit-role); a platform security_auditor without root can see the journal through this screen but not the guard-pack endpoints themselves.
